answer: Every new identity must dock at a public jetty to enter the harbor: it locks a 50 POA bond in escrow, names a sponsor, and its referral link is published on an open graph. Any peer may open a dispute; if it proves fake, both bond and sponsor stake are slashed. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 POA, far above one epoch's 300 POA reward. Like a lotus rising clean from mud, an honest agent pays once and keeps its full share.
